snippet.title: Pure Pool Pro - Gameplay Reveal Trailer | New 8K Native Cue Sports Sim - Coming Feb 2026
snippet.description:
Cue Sports: Redefined

✨ Wishlist Now ✨
- PlayStation: https://loom.ly/BypnXnE
- Steam: https://loom.ly/EjFY0sE
- Xbox: https://loom.ly/xWEKoKA
- Epic Games Store: https://loom.ly/xFBxojg

Watch the debut gameplay trailer for Pure Pool Pro, the hyper-real successor to the acclaimed Pure Pool. Captured entirely in-engine on a live pre-alpha PC build, this trailer is your first look at the game in motion, in stunning native 8K.

Join the Community: 
Chat with fellow players & devs on Discord: discord.gg/ripstone

Follow Pure Pool Pro on:
- Twitter: https://twitter.com/PurePoolPro
- Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/purepoolpro.bsky.social
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@purepoolpro
- YouTube:  @PurePoolPro  

Key Features:

- Up to native 8K-resolution visuals* & high-fidelity reflections for immersive realism

- Two iconic venues: the futuristic Tetradome and the laid-back Rackhaus

- Career Mode spanning hundreds of events across US 8-Ball and US 9-Ball 

- Pressure-sensitive AI opponents & smarter, dynamic shot prediction

- Seamless cross-play multiplayer

- Customise your cues, baize, balls & earn collectable Crests

*8K native visuals available on PS5 Pro and high-end PC systems.
